description: Rank countries by Fragile States Index score — the N most fragile or N most stable countries in one call, with rank and score. PREFER for "most fragile countries", "most stable/least fragile countries", "top 10 failed states", "which countries are at highest state-fragility risk". direction defaults to "most_fragile".

direction.description: Which end of the ranking to return. Default "most_fragile".

limit.description: How many countries to return (default 10, max 50).

name: fsi_ranking
